2. Brief facts of the case are that the petitioner, an agriculturist by occupation, is the recorded khatedar of agricultural land comprised in Khasra Nos. 1071 and 1072 situated in Village Dudi Nagar @ Bhaktinagar, Tehsil Aau, District Phalodi.
The petitioner cultivates this land for his livelihood, resides in a house constructed thereon, and uses it for keeping cattle and storing cattle feed.
Adjacent land bearing Khasra No. 1310/1068, owned by Smt. Usha Kanwar, Smt. Priyanka Rathore and Himmat Singh, has been leased to a private respondent company for establishing a 100 MW Solar Plant.

After that for connecting the plant to the 220 KV GSS at Village Aau, the private respondent company is laying an electricity transmission line and has already erected high-tension (HT) electricity poles on both sides of the petitioner's agricultural land, proposing to pass the HT line through the middle of his field.
The proposed alignment, which fails to maintain required safety clearances, poses a serious risk to the petitioner, his family, and his cattle.

Despite using his land for residential and agricultural purposes, no proceedings for acquisition have been (Uploaded on 05/12/2025 at 05:31:30 PM) [2025:RJ-JD:52698] (3 of 4) [CW-23639/2025] initiated, nor any compensation paid before encroaching upon his land for laying transmission lines.

Repeated representations by the petitioner to the district administration, respondent authorities, and the private respondent company requesting realignment of the transmission line have gone unaddressed.
Instead, the respondents continue with the illegal work without considering his grievance.
Hence, the writ petition.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in similar controversy, this Court has disposed of the writ petition vide order dated 17.10.2025 passed in SBCWP No.20449/2025 (Kuldeep Choudhary Vs. State of Rajasthan & Ors.) with certain directions.
